digest.component_or_area: tickets store fsck repair and diagnostics
propositions: 561 pre-existing fsck diagnostics (550 SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL, 10 ORPHAN_EVENT, 1 STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED) must be repaired during a quiet maintenance window while preserving the intentional resolved-fork audit finding.
A new --only=stale-channel selector must be added to rebar fsck --repair to enable narrow, batched, resumable stale-channel snapshot repair through the existing commit-and-push infrastructure.
The stale-channel repair must refuse any ticket that also has SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT or ORPHAN_EVENT findings to prevent incomplete repairs of mixed faults.
All 10 orphan events in the baseline are LINK type and AUTO-RECOVER dispositioned; they must be repaired first before stale-channel repair to ensure proper fault isolation and ordering.

Dry-run, batching, push-failure abort, mixed-fault refusal, rollback capability, and the residual STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED audit finding must be verified through rehearsal in a disposable repository before live execution.
